description: This file implements core chess engine logic including move generation, move application, position management, and game state evaluation for a two-player local chess game. It defines classes for representing moves, positions, and game rules, and includes methods for move validation, check/checkmate detection, and SAN notation.

classes.name: PlayedMove
classes.description: Represents a move with SAN notation and metadata (check/checkmate).

classes.name: ChessPosition
classes.description: Represents a full chess position including board state, side to move, castling rights, en passant target, and move counters.

classes.name: ChessEngine
classes.description: Main rules engine for move generation, move application, and game state evaluation.

classes.name: MoveApplyResult
classes.description: Result of applying a move, including the new position and SAN notation.

classes.name: _HistoryEntry
classes.description: Internal class for tracking move history for undo/redo functionality.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes objects to JSON for persistence or communication.

methods.name: generateLegalMoves
methods.description: Generates all legal moves for the current position.

methods.name: tryPlayMove
methods.description: Attempts to play a move if it is legal, updating game state.

methods.name: isKingInCheck
methods.description: Checks if the king of a given color is in check.
